title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-controlled, Safety and Efficacy Study of VI-0106 (Extended-release Tacrolimus) in Subjects with PAH and Functional Limitations Despite Optimized Therapy with Available PAH Medications
official: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-controlled, Safety and Efficacy Study of VI-0106 (Extended-release Tacrolimus) in Subjects with PAH and Functional Limitations Despite Optimized Therapy with Available PAH Medications
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the effect of VI-0106 on functional outcomes, pulmonary hemodynamics, and risk markers in subjects with PAH and functional limitations despite optimized treatment with available PAH medications.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adults age 18 to 75 years inclusive
2. Diagnosis of WHO Group 1 Pulmonary Hypertension: PAH
3. WHO functional class II - IV despite optimized treatment with one or more modalities including PDE5 inhibitors, guanylate cyclase stimulators, endothelin receptor antagonists, prostanoids, and activin signaling inhibitors. Treatments for PAH must be stable for at least 3 months (at least 6 months for activin signaling inhibitors) at the time of screening
4. Screening (or within 3 months prior to screening) right heart catheterization (RHC) mean pulmonary arterial pressure (PAP) ≥25 mmHg; pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP) ≤15 mmHg or left ventricular end diastolic pressure (LVEDP) ≤15 mmHg; and pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) ≥480 dynes/sec/cm-5 (6 Woods units)
5. Screening 6MWD >75 meters to ≤450 meters. Measurements should be repeated with at least 4 hours (but within 1 week) between attempts, and distances must be within 15% of each other using the highest value as a reference
6. If female of child-bearing potential, willing to use highly effective methods of contraception
Exclusion criteria:
1. Total Lung Capacity (TLC) <60% predicted. If TLC ≥60% but <70% predicted, interstitial lung disease of greater than mild severity should be excluded by CT scan
2. Active infection requiring antibiotic, antifungal, or antiviral therapies
3. Current systemic treatment with cyclosporine
4. Known allergy or hypersensitivity to tacrolimus
5. Non-adherence to local vaccination recommendations given the subject’s overall health status or significant psychiatric, addictive, or other disorder that compromises the subject's ability to provide informed consent, follow study protocol, or adhere to study treatment
6. FEV1/FVC <70% predicted or FEV1 <60% predicted
7. Evidence of left-sided heart disease including: o Significant aortic or mitral valve disease o LVEF <45% o Pericardial constriction o Restrictive cardiomyopathy o Significant coronary disease with demonstrable ischemia;
8. Inability to safely attempt completion of the 6MWD test
9. Life expectancy <6 months
10. eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2 (CKD-EPI equation)
11. Moderate to severe hepatic dysfunction (Child-Pugh score >10);
12. Serum potassium >5.1 mEq/L;
13. Use of experimental PAH treatments within the past 3 months;
